symptom: describe -> exec of TestApp WorkflowCommons.Snip_WorkflowActivityRecord_Header (Mendix 11.14.0): mx check CE0117 'Error(s) in expression.' at Text 'text4', a parameter reading $WorkflowActivityRecord/System.WorkflowActivityRecord_WorkflowSubProcess/Caption
cause: modelsdk/meta's System module (extracted from 11.6.4) had no System.WorkflowSubProcess, WorkflowSubProcessDefinition, their associations or System.WorkflowSubProcessState, so the association path could not resolve and the builder stored the parameter as an expression
insight: Two measurements, two sources: attributes, types and String lengths from the model.mdp of a deploy build (mxcli docker build -o writes app/model/model.mdp; mx check does not), and the introducing version from the names in Mendix.Modeler.Core.dll per version (mxcli setup mxbuild --version X, grep, delete; ~1.6 GB each). Bisect with a control name that exists in every version (WorkflowActivityRecord_Actor), or 'absent' cannot be told from 'the model is stored elsewhere'. Result: absent 11.6.0/11.7.0, present 11.8.0 onward; 11.8.0 alone also has WorkflowActivityDetails_WorkflowSubProcess. Gate the ENTITY and derive its associations' presence from their ends (as RuntimeOnly already did), so new associations need no per-row version. A test whose count assumed every System enumeration exists for the 11.6.6 fixture is the gate working, not a regression: compare against the version-aware list.
